name: net_tab_back_waits_for_resync_behind
description: Three seats; client 3 has 400 ms each way. Its tab hides for 200 frames from tick 1740, across tick 1800, a checkpoint tick: the other two agree on 1800 (a strict majority, 2 s after their reports) and the checkpoint is kept while client 3 is hidden. Shown again about 200 ticks behind, client 3 says catching_up, holds its HASHes and runs the turns it buffered at catch-up speed. The sequencer answers with RESYNC(behind) from 1800 at once, but that reaches the game a round trip later, after its own catch-up has ended and it has said shown. The hold stays until the server's answer is known: the PING sent behind the VISIBILITY names the server's open turn, and a RESYNC queues every later turn behind it, so the RESYNC comes first. No HASH past 1800 goes out from the run it held; the game loads the RESYNC, re-runs from 1800 and stays in the match (review M4 round 2: a HASH past the checkpoint before the RESYNC made the re-run's go back, 'HASH ticks must increase').

steps.msg: setup: the checkpoint past client 3's last hash was kept while it was hidden
setup: shown again and behind, it said catching_up
the race: its own catch-up ended, and it said shown, before RESYNC(behind) arrived
the RESYNC came before any HASH past the checkpoint went out from the run it held
the tab that came back is still in the match
its re-run's hashes agree with the others' from the checkpoint on
